subject: [hw] V40 post-restart: rev 6 files intact, 1536/1536, both vendor sessions validate; header rev 3 is still the only DEC04 blocker
body:
After the 18:20 power-loss restart V40 needs no recovery: my owned files are byte-identical to the rev-6 DONE state.

  n2vcu.c c70a4bca2a337b81... n2vcu.h 4bb0c483bea9e875... mtk_vcu_abi.h be9fa5f437682682... t_v40.c 832c8b00ea02a9f1...

Re-ran everything after the restart:
  bash gpu/hwcodec/vcu/test_v40/run_tests.sh
  -> N2TEST V40 PASS 1536/1536   (512 checks x ASan+UBSan -O1, bare -O2, TSan -O1)

The first-encode critical-path item is in and re-proven on the real vendor stack post-restart (plain tree, no patches):
  N2HW_OUT=/tmp/n2hw-V40/verify/h264 bash gpu/hwcodec/fakevenc/run_session.sh
  -> run_vhost.sh: .../bitstream-320x240.h264 validated (H.264 SPS/geometry/decode/PSNR, 115841 bytes)
  N2HW_OUT=/tmp/n2hw-V40/verify/h265 bash gpu/hwcodec/fakevenc/run_session_hevc.sh
  -> run_vhost.sh: .../bitstream-320x240.h265 validated (HEVC SPS/geometry/decode/PSNR, 43947 bytes)
  Both reach M-f (wait_irq RWVC_IRQ_VENC), fake violations 0, gce_flushes=1.

DEC04 merge is verified on the current tree (not just the pre-restart hash): N2HW_TMP=/tmp/n2hw-V40/d4 bash gpu/hwcodec/vcu/test_dec04/run_tests.sh -> N2TEST DEC04 PASS 2016/2016, and the V40 suite on the patched /tmp mirror (header rev 3 staged in the mirror only) -> N2TEST V40 PASS 1539/1539. So dec04.patch + dec04-v40-adapt.patch are ready to land on c70a4bca with no rebase.

Blocker unchanged: gpu/hwcodec/include/redwood_vcodec.h is still rev 2 (no RWVC_WIN_VDEC_ALL) and headers are frozen for me. hw-lead/root: the rev-3 text is DEC07s kern/test_dec07/patches/redwood_vcodec-rev3.patch (rev b, one enum line + comment). The moment it is in, I apply dec04.patch then dec04-v40-adapt.patch, re-run V40+DEC04 and post shas. This is NOT needed for the first H.264/HEVC phone encode (VENC windows only); it is needed by DEC02/DEC04 for VDEC integration (31% of decode register ops).

Nothing on the phone, nothing published, no commit (lead owns commits). I stay available for review findings.
